summary: Vivani Medical filed a 424B5 resale prospectus supplement covering up to 3,947,368 shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants. The shares are registered for resale by selling warrant holders, not sold by the company; Vivani receives no proceeds. Warrants stem from a March 1, 2024 securities purchase agreement. Common stock trades on Nasdaq under VANI, last at $1.23 on September 24, 2026, with no established market for the warrants. Resale registration does not obligate holders to exercise or sell. The filing is a routine registration statement, not a special situation.
